nsp_notes: "The foundation of the great abbey of St. Savior in Lingua Phari at Messina by Roger II in 1131-34, and the organization of most of the Greek houses of Sicily under its archimandrite into a sort of congregation, has generally been regarded as the climax of the Hellenic renaissance in the Norman realm. But it was actually a desperate effort to check the dissolution of Count Roger I's work of restoration." White (n. 5) says that he has not been able to explain why certain ones remained independent of the abbey. (45)

According to Pirri, this monastery was one of the communities that came under St. Savior's jurisdiction. It is not clear to us, though, what the relationship is between the "S. Stephanus apud Messanam" in this group and the "S. Stephanus apud Mess." that is included in communities that remained independent.
Scaduto's date of earliest attestation is 1144, some 10 years later than White's. (99)
Giunta repeats 1144 as the date of earliest attestation.
